Roosterkoek Poppie goes to Italy

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We follow Poppie Van As's journey from Lainsburg to introducing Italy to the Roostekoek

Unique Selling Point:
Poppie Van As come from nothing. She was married at 13 and moved to her husbands farm but 26 years later she got divorced and started a new life in Lainsburg where one man gave her a table, some chairs and the fire to create her roostekoek stand. Over the years people traveled to Lainsburg for Tannie Poppies roostekoek. 6 years ago Stan was cycling through the town when he met Poppie and her roostekoek, since that day he has taken Poppie and her Roostekoek stand to almost all of his cycle races Most recently the organisors of a big Italian race tasted Poppies Roostekoek in SA, heard her story and invited her to come have a stand at a race in Italy. Stan managed to raise over 100k and Poppie went to Italy!
Poppie packed her bags boarded a plane for the first time, left the country for the first time and took her roostekoeks to Italy! Her entire experience was visually documented by Stan and makes for a compelling watch :)

Script:


Time code Visual Character
00:00 Voice over Poppy Van As owns a tiny cooking store in Laingsburg for over 60 years she has lived a simple life until she me cyclist Stan Engelbrecht.
00:11 Macfarlane link When Stan Engelbrecht cycled into Laingsburg and bought a Roostebread from Poppy Van As none of them knew that this moment would form a bond that has lasted over 6 years and would take Poppy from the Karoo to Italy
00:24 Back buddy campaign Italy here comes Poppy
00:27 MacFarlane and Stan interview Stan: Poppy and I met about 7 years ago and she had an incredible energy and positivity and funny full of jokes and she made an impression on me
00:39 Eroica Cycle Tour Footage

Voice over Stan was so taken with Poppy he invited her to sell roostebread at the cycle races he organizes around the Karoo and she has been in every event since.
00:48 Poppy and Macfarlane interview Poppy: After that first cycle tour, my life changed completely. My business started growing, so Stan and I walked a road together. He really made me explore the world

What kind of bread do you want?

Stan: uhm… Cheese

Poppy: I have jam and cheese – R25
I have wors and relish – R35
01:10 Stan She came to work on Eroica which is an Italian event which I organize in Montague. Just to give you a background, Eroica is like a vintage cycling operation. Its paying homage to a whole way of cycling racing
01:26 Voice overt The Italian organizers of Eroica were so taken with Poppy that they invited her to make bread in the main even in Guyana Italy. Stan started a campaign to get poppy to Italy and she became and internet sensation
01:45 Stan We started with a little Instagram account for her and suddenly there was like an out pouring support and there was interest in her life, interview request, she just started blowing up in her life
01:55 Voice over They managed to raise R45000 overnight
02:01 Stan So, I phone poppy up a few days later and I said to her “Poppy you got to get your passport ready we are going to Italy”. She started screaming over the phone and I was worried that she was going to have a heart attack. She was over the moon and she could hardly speak over the phone
02:14 Poppy Listen, the day I got into the aeroplane people were sitting and we chatted, we joked. But when it started moving the plane started taking off then I said “here comes Mama oooooooh”
Macfarlane: how did it feel to land in Italy? What was it like?
Poppy: I felt like a child with a new toy but a child who has never had a toy before. Listen here that is such a beautiful place. I’m still experiencing the world. It is green everywhere. The buildings are high, the streets are narrow

03:00 Stan Before we flew to Italy people said to Poppy you are going to make bread in Italy? Where are you going to find wood? You are going to have to take firewood from here
03:10 Poppy The people said to me Tannie Poppy, Italy does not have wood. I said I have a to toast my bread even if I have to toast it inside a building it won’t taste the same but I will do it but when I did make the toast bread I went to fetch my own wood in the forest. An the next thing there was Stan also with a tree.
03:32 Poppy in Italy This is nice woos this is nice wood, nice wood. Italy has tonnes of wood guys, tonnes
03:39 MacFarlane What would you say were some of the biggest highlight in this trip?

Stan: We got a message from a south African who live in Rome and she was very taken by poppy’s story she reached out to poppy and invited her to visit the Vatican
03:54 Poppy You know, those churches awaken something inside you and the biggest church in Rome that was just as beautiful they say that church has been there hundreds of years and they look as beautiful even today.
04:12 Stan She asked me to help translate the question she wanted to ask the priest and the question was “why is my life so upside down? “when she came out she was very very emotional. On the surface, her life can seem very romantic for someone looking form the outside you know. Maybe a photograph or video, lights are always beautiful you know this woman walking along a river bed carrying firewood it’s a romantic image. But the reality is Poppy’s life is extremely hard, it’s very difficult to do what she does everyday
04:49 Macfarlane Poppy grew up in the middle of the Karoo. She was married at 13 and has 6 children and 14 grandkids that she supports, life has been far from a fairy tale for her.
04:58 Macfarlane and Poppy Macfarlane: why were you married at such a young age?

Poppy: I got pregnant so I had to get married, at that early age I had to marry the man. Life was very difficult, I didn’t know the duties of a housewife because I was a child who had just left school. On many days, he argued with me whether I was pregnant or not. If he wanted to hit me he did,
05:28 Stan and MacFarlane Macfarlane: You two come from different world I mean Poppy from Laingsburg and you know a guy form Cape Town how does this relationship work?

Stan: I guess it’s unusual friendship. You know she plays the character of poppy with the cuppy and the big smile and the face, she plays it extremely well even though behind the scenes this are going very difficult some times. I don’t know how she does that, I often wear my heart on my sleeves and I struggle to..., I could never do what she does. I don’t know how she does it.
06:01 Poppy Stan and my friendship means a lot to me. I told him the other day he’s life a father to me. I don’t have a father anymore in times of need I can tell him about my problems, he’s there to help. He is like an eldest son to me, yes and he’s lie a man to me. A man is someone whose should you can lean on
06:26 Voice over Stan and Poppy’s friendship has continued to grow and has now even turned into a documentary film as Stan has decided to document her journey form the Karoo to Italy
06:37 Poppy speaking at a conference I experienced a great team spirit in this place which was so wonderful
06:43 Macfarlane and Stan Macfarlane: Would you say Poppy’s life has changed? As a result of all of this?

Stan: yes and no. poppy life is a 1000 much complex than myself or anybody that could fathom she has a huge family and a lot of people depending on her so you can say because she has gotten a little famous on the internet more people are coming to buy friend from her so that makes a small difference from her day to day life but it’s not enough meaningful money to make a change.
07:13 Poppy Everyone says “auntie Poppy, you’re famous now” your known worldwide and you’re right up there. But you know what, I don’t feel famous at all. I’m still down here but I can’t make toasted bread up there. I must do it here, so I want to stay right here where I am, you understand?
